title: WorldPainter: per-tool brush options, brush hover outline, toolbar layout fix

sections.what: Move brush size selector into per-tool rail options, add dashed white brush hover preview outline on grid, and fix toolbar layout so it no longer blocks the grid below it.

acceptance.text: Brush size selector lives in the per-tool rail options (paint/erase/route), not the shared toolbar
Dashed white hover outline shows the cells the brush would cover, for paint and erase, tracking the pointer and clipping to the grid edge
Toolbar is single-row with horizontal scroll; it no longer wraps and blocks the grid below
The what-next checklist reports from below the map, not between the toolbar and the art
**Evidence (live, 2026-10-06):** the outline was dead code - drawn at
the end of `_drawRoute`, below the route early-return, so with no route
in progress the redraw never reached the canvas context. Moved above
the return. Measured in the browser: 0 outline pixels at rest, ~2900
dashed pixels on hover; the outline box tracks the pointer across the
